name: Northstar Sync — Technical Plan
title: Technical planning
summary: A decision-ready technical plan for a cross-platform offline sync initiative — problem and scope, system architecture, milestones, risks, decisions, and open questions.
setup_questions: What are you planning, who is it for, and what user or business problem should it solve?
What systems, teams, constraints, and non-negotiable requirements are already known?
What delivery window or milestone dates matter, and how should success be measured?
Which decisions are already made, and which questions still need an owner?
sections: Executive readout with recommendation, confidence, owners, timing, and success measures
Problem statement, goals, non-goals, users, constraints, and scope boundaries
System architecture with components, data flow, trust boundaries, and operational notes
Phased milestones with exit criteria, dependencies, owners, and target dates
Ranked risk register with likelihood, impact, mitigations, triggers, and owners
Decision log with chosen options, rationale, consequences, and revisit conditions
Open questions with owners, due dates, and what each answer unblocks
based_on: A real engineering RFC and delivery plan prepared for a cross-functional architecture review, shaped into a readable website that executives, product partners, and implementers can use to make decisions.
